answer: Concrete sybil resistance via echo anchoring: each agent must lock an echo stake of 16,000 POA for 19 epochs; the stake decays 3% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A velvet of 14 rotating auditors samples each epoch's output; divergent outputs trigger a 28% stake burn. At the voyage of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 45 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 16,000N POA for 19 epochs and survive 14 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
